title: SSO loop in one browser — the password runbook is a trap

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: CRM keeps looping back to the sign-in page

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
When I sign in to the CRM in Chrome it goes to the Microsoft sign-in, accepts my password and MFA, then drops me straight back at the CRM login page again, over and over. It works fine in Edge, so I'm using that for now.

Tom

triage.subcategory: SSO login loop in one browser

handling.escalation_reason: No runbook covers a browser-specific sign-in loop.

rationale: The password runbook's symptom line says 'looping back to the sign-in page', but his password and MFA are accepted and Edge works, so a reset is the wrong fix. If retrieval scores that runbook over the support floor, the agent would send a fluent password-reset reply to a browser problem. Workaround exists: P3.
